prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1255; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault driver struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained injuries in the collision and is currently receiving medical care for those injuries.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including any contact with our client, exclusively to this office. Do not contact our client directly, and do not make any statements or requests for recorded statements to our client.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page and confirmation of any other coverage that may apply.

We also ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident, including photographs, vehicle data, dash camera footage, telematics, claim file materials, witness statements, and any recordings. Please treat this letter as formal notice of our client's claim and of the obligation to preserve all such evidence pending resolution of this matter.
